notice.title: Bring your own local model
notice.body: COS now supports Ollama. Install Ollama on this Mac, pull a model, and COS offers it as a fourth model family next to Claude, Codex, and Cursor. Replies on that model run entirely on your Mac. When the daemon is live, About shows an Ollama row with the model name, and Doctor confirms it. Needs server 6.39.1 or newer. Nothing to configure if you skip it.
